aboutPage.title: About
aboutPage.description: Learn more about Md. Tariqul Islam — a full-stack web developer in Bangladesh specializing in Next.js, React, TypeScript, Python, Django and AI-powered web applications.
aboutPage.heading: About Me
aboutPage.intro: I'm Md. Tariqul Islam, a full-stack web developer from Savar, Dhaka, Bangladesh. I build fast, SEO-friendly and scalable web applications using modern technologies. Here's the full story.
aboutPage.storySub: From curious student to full-stack developer.
aboutPage.story1: I started building websites out of curiosity — tweaking HTML templates, breaking CSS layouts, and figuring out why things didn't work. That curiosity turned into a passion for creating digital products that solve real problems.
aboutPage.story2: Today, I specialize in building full-stack web applications with Next.js, React, TypeScript, Python and Django. I focus on performance, SEO, and clean user experiences. Whether it's an AI-powered study platform, an e-commerce store, or a developer portfolio — I enjoy the process of turning ideas into working products.
aboutPage.story3: When I'm not coding, I'm exploring new technologies, contributing to open source, and writing about what I learn. I believe in building things that are fast, accessible, and useful.
aboutPage.journeySub: Education and experience that shaped me.
